scope: Selected original 48-coordinate PBW and Spin/Clifford contraction frontier. Not a claim to mirror every accepted FCP theorem.

classification_definitions.ACCEPTED_PRESENT: Independently qualified owner mathematics present at its recorded source blob.
classification_definitions.ACCEPTED_MISSING: Required qualified FCP mathematics with no owner candidate present.
classification_definitions.CANDIDATE_STAGED: Source or adaptation present; independent owner gate not accepted.
classification_definitions.SUPERSEDED: A historical source version replaced by a later documented version, not a theorem refutation.
classification_definitions.EXCLUDED: Outside the selected dependency closure; source acceptance status is not inferred.
